data.title: Colombia declares state of emergency after quake kills 111
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Colombia on Monday declared a state of emergency following a powerful earthquake that caused at least 111 deaths and flattened dozens of buildings, trapping more victims underneath.

data.title: Trump insists Netanyahu relationship 'very good' despite Gaza rift
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump insisted on Monday that his relationship with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is "very good" despite the Israeli leader's rejection of a US-led Gaza plan.

data.title: Russia bars only anti-war party from elections
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia's Supreme Court on Monday barred the country's only anti-war party, Yabloko, from contesting September's parliamentary elections.

data.title: 'Dreams disappear' as Gaza students await evacuation to Italy
data.description: ROME - Dozens of Gaza students who won scholarships to universities in Italy are still waiting to be evacuated due to bureaucratic red tape, leaving qualified students in a deadly conflict zone, AFP has found.

data.title: Turkey MPs back historic law on reintegrating Kurdish militants
data.description: ISTANBUL - Turkish lawmakers on Monday voted through a bill offering limited amnesty for Kurdish PKK militants, a key step in the peace process that seeks to end decades of deadly violence.

data.title: Chinese syndicate aide arrested in B54m crypto laundering case
data.description: A suspected right-hand man of a Chinese crime boss has been arrested in Bangkok in connection with an online fraud and money laundering network believed to have washed more than 54 million baht through cryptocurrency.

data.title: Drought forces water restrictions across nearly 70% of France
data.description: PARIS — Nearly 70% of France is subject to water-use restrictions as drought conditions worsen amid successive heatwaves, the government said Monday.

data.title: Dolphin, Dim-sum, Banyan: How tropical cyclones get their names
data.description: NEW YORK — If you see that a storm named Dim-sum is gathering steam in the Pacific Ocean, it’s not an error.

data.title: UK radio broke rules in announcing king's death: watchdog
data.description: LONDON - A community radio station breached the rules after accidentally announcing the death of King Charles III in a May broadcast, a UK watchdog said on Monday.

data.title: Europe braces for another summer heatwave
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Much of Europe is bracing for yet another heatwave following periods of scorching temperatures that have driven rivers to record lows, ignited historic forest fires and contributed to thousands of deaths.

data.title: Amazon founder Bezos nears deal to buy stake in Liverpool
data.description: BENGALURU - A consortium ⁠that ⁠includes Amazon founder ​Jeff Bezos is close to agreeing a deal ​to acquire a stake ‌of about one-third in Premier League club Liverpool, multiple media outlets reported on Monday.

data.title: Days of heavy rain leave at least 13 dead in Philippines
data.description: MANILA - Floods, landslides and accidents driven by a nine-day downpour equivalent to more than a month's worth of rain in some areas have killed at least 13 people in the northern Philippines, rescuers said Monday.

data.title: Ex-Thai MP shoots dead local official over money row
data.description: BANGKOK - A former Thai MP on Monday shot dead a local government official in broad daylight over a financial dispute before being arrested and confessing to journalists at the police station.

data.title: Take a look at Marilyn Monroe’s lipstick in the first makeup archive of its kind
data.description: What do Marilyn Monroe, celluloid powder and cosmetics dating back to the 17th century have in common? They can now be found under one digital roof.

data.title: Embattled Infantino target of letter from three confederations
data.description: LAUSANNE — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president Gianni Infantino came under renewed fire on Monday as a joint letter from three confederations -- Union of European Football Associations (Uefa), Central America and Caribbean Association Football (Concacaf) and Asian Football Confederation (AFC) -- declared football "belongs to no individual".

data.title: Record July heat in regions home to 900 million people
data.description: PARIS — Regions home to around 900 million people experienced their hottest July on record in 2026, including in the Sahel, Central America, France and Spain, according to Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) analysis of Copernicus data.

data.title: FAA ordered structural checks don't affect Thailand's 737 MAX planes
data.description: The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand said an airworthiness directive (AD) issued by the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for structural investigations of Boeing 737 MAX planes does not affect the 12 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft based in Thailand.

data.title: Police seek charges against Bangkok bar owner for deadly fire
data.description: Thai police intend to charge the owner of a Bangkok bar with six offences, including negligence, over a fire last month that killed 37 people, the lead investigator said Monday.

data.title: US, South Korea to drill for new threats from North
data.description: SEOUL — South Korean and US forces will hold major joint drills next week simulating combat against North Korean troops battle-hardened by deployment in the Russia-Ukraine war, an exercise spokesman said Monday.

data.title: Former MP blames debt dispute for shooting of PAO president
data.description: Former MP Chalong Riewraeng cited a debt dispute as prompting him to fatally shoot Nonthaburi Provincial Administration Organisation (PAO) chief Thongchai Yenprasert on Monday, a senior officer said.

data.title: Miscommunication blamed for sacked foreign teacher's threatening post
data.description: SONGKHLA - The director of Hatyaiwittayalai secondary school said on Monday that miscommunication might have led to the threatening online post by a sacked foreign teacher.

data.title: 13 foreigners netted in property-nominee blitz in Hua Hin
data.description: Thirteen foreigners were arrested on Monday when police raided a housing and pool-villa estate in Hua Hin, after they were found using Thai nominee shareholders to buy properties for them.

data.title: Clothes rack falls from highrise onto taxi-motorcyclist
data.description: A clothes-drying rack fell from a highrise balcony onto a motorcycle driver and his passenger in soi Sukhumvit 24, causing the driver to swerve into a nearby car stopped in the traffic.

data.title: Thai property groups sell land to boost liquidity and cut costs
data.description: Property Perfect, Pruksa, Bangkok Land and BJC are offering land and assets worth more than THB20bn as developers prioritise cash flow and lower holding costs.

data.title: Chinese syndicate aide arrested in B54bn crypto laundering case
data.description: A suspected right-hand man of a Chinese crime boss has been arrested in Bangkok in connection with an online fraud and money laundering network believed to have washed more than 54 million baht through cryptocurrency.

data.title: Songsaeng Autotires marks nearly 60 years in Thailand, three generations strong
data.description: Songsaeng Autotires, a family-owned automotive service and tyre company in Thailand, has reaffirmed its commitment to quality service and customer trust as it marks nearly six decades in business, a legacy now carried by its third generation.

data.title: One woman confirmed dead in western Canada wildfire
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - An 80-year-old woman died while fleeing her home to escape a massive wildfire in Canada's British Columbia province, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) said late Sunday.

data.title: CP AXTRA posts H1 2026 revenue of B268.33bn, online sales up 29%
data.description: CP AXTRA Public Company Limited (The Company or CPAXT), the operator of “Makro and Lotus’s,” Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% announced its operating results for the first half of 2026, with total revenue of 268,334 million baht, an increase of 3.6% year-on-year. Online sales via the Makro PRO platform and Lotus’s SMART App grew more than 29%, Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% and out-of-store sales continued to expand, underscoring the strength of the Company’s omnichannel strategy. The Company also advanced its “Happy & Healthy Mall” strategy, raising mall occupancy rates, particularly at newly transformed locations. Together, these results mark a new milestone in enhancing customer experience by seamlessly connecting the three core pillars of the Company’s Retail Ecosystem: online channels, physical stores and shopping mall spaces.

data.title: Former MP arrested after PAO president slain
data.description: Former Nonthaburi MP Chalong Riewraeng was arrested after a man stormed into the provincial administration organisation office and shot dead the PAO president, Thongchai Yenprasert, on Monday morning.

data.title: Chiang Mai safe from flooding, more rain this week
data.description: Irrigation officials have moved to calm fears that Chiang Mai city may be flooded, stressing that the level of the Ping river, a major waterway, remains far below the crisis level.

data.title: Frenzied Thai on Malaysia-Bangkok flight an army officer with mental issues
data.description: Passengers on a flight from Malaysia to Bangkok were startled by a Thai man who became agitated mid-journey, repeatedly shouting demands for the aircraft to land and reportedly attempting to open an exit door.
